title: Independent-route verification of one-dimensional defect extraction
status_detail: Proposed second follow-on after blind alignment. No independent Bloch-fiber extraction route or route-commutativity result is active, calculated, or accepted.
objective: Compare the accepted real-space defect extraction with an independently implemented Bloch-fiber or folding route and test path commutativity after declared alignment.
authorized_scope: Plan an independently implemented momentum-space extraction route using the same frozen synthetic parent, supercell, planted defects, and represented-space conventions as the accepted baseline.
Compare real-space extraction followed by transformation with transformation followed by fiberwise extraction, after applying the same declared alignment and energy-reference maps.
Retain representation, alignment, quadrature or mesh, truncation, route, spectral, and wavefunction discrepancies as separate diagnostics.
completion_criteria: The two independently implemented routes agree within a frozen numerical tolerance for null, local, nonlocal, collinear, and spin-mixing controls when their mathematical operations commute.
Deliberately changed fitting domains, weights, truncations, or unmatched maps produce explicit noncommutativity or stopping results rather than nominal agreement.
Implementation independence, deterministic inputs, independent verification, provenance, and bounded limitations are documented.
exclusions: No route may establish independence merely by importing the other route's extraction implementation.
Route agreement does not establish material validity, continuum validity, scientific validation, or transferability.
No material calculation, external execution, dependency change, or public API freeze is authorized.
